title: Partner profile | Disclosure, awareness and management of environmental impact are at the core of CDP

text.text: Disclosure, awareness and management of environmental
impact are at the core of CDP
What is in it for you?
of sustainability for companies and cities – focused on climate (GHG), deforestation and water security
and best practices associated with environmental leadership (ambition, meaningful targets)
in disclosure, feedback, gap analysis and capacity building as well as data/insights into environmental impact
with the purpose of disclosing for investors and customers
- 590 investors (+110 trillion USD in assets) and 200+ large purchasers (+5 trillion USD in spend) require CDP disclosure
Collaborates with a wide array of organizations
including investors, fund providers, and inter- & non-governmental associations
Relevant for companies, organizations, countries & cities
into environmental impact and benchmark to peers and other industries
on how to improve your GHG performance
For additional information on CDP please contact Sune Kok
